glosses: to unbolt, to unscrew, to untwist, to unwarp, to unwind (to take something out of something else by turning its threads; to detach the part that covers or attaches something after removing the screws)
to uncap, to unscrew (to remove the cap from a container)
to loosen, to uncap (to open or increase the supply of something by turning something, e.g. gas)
to turn something the other way
to unscrew (to restore something to its original state or to back out of something)
to get unbolted, to get unscrewed, to get untwisted, to get unwarped, to get unwound (to become detached or disconnected from something)
to get unscrewed (to lose attachment to something by a thread or screw)
to get uncapped, to get unscrewed (to be opened)
to turn around (to change the position of the body by turning in the opposite direction)
